prices.note: Gap Inc. product API that the category page itself calls (commerceProductsSearchUrl in the page source), read with curl and the StylodexBot UA. Women's jeans only (shorts, overalls, skirts, jackets, shirts, pants and capris excluded). Price = the store's regularPrice for colorways not marked down: priceType R, or P (a temporary promotion) without a markdown flag; priceType M and colorways flagged 'price as marked', clearance or final sale excluded. Women's jeans cid=85729, brand=on, pages 0-2 (72 styles, 410 colorways). 41 jeans styles qualify: $34.99 (Curvy Mid-Rise Wow Bootcut, Curvy High-Waisted Wow Wide-Leg) to $69.99 (Old Navy x Altuzarra High-Waisted Baggy Wide-Leg and Straight Leg). Most at $44.99-$54.99 (OG, Vintage Slim, Rockstar, Baggy Barrel lines); the Wow line sits at $34.99-$39.99. Promo flags on kept items: 'App Exclusive Extra 20% Off', 'Hot Deal + App Exclusive Extra 20% Off'.

Gap Inc. product API (cid 15292, brand on, market us), StylodexBot UA: 69 styles; 26 non-dresses (skirts, bottoms, etc.) excluded; 43 dresses, 34 with only marked-down or out-of-stock colorways excluded. 9 regular: low High-Neck Jersey Mini Swing Dress $34.99; Sleeveless Fit & Flare Ponte Mini Dress $39.99; high The Occasion by Old Navy Long-Sleeve Tie-Front Maxi Dress $59.99.

Gap Inc. product API the category page calls (cid 72091, brand on, market us, 20 pages, StylodexBot UA): 747 styles, of which 181 typed 'womens tops', 'womens short-sleeved tees' or 'z womens graphic tees' (men's tees, Dropship third-party listings, activewear, sweaters, sweatshirts, sleepwear and bras excluded, plus titles naming sweaters, cardigans, hoodies, jackets, vests and the like). Regular = regularPrice of in-stock colorways with priceType R, or P (temporary promotion) without a markdown, clearance, final-sale or 'price as marked' flag. 106 styles qualify: low First-Layer Ribbed Scoop-Neck Tank Top and First-Layer Cami Tank Top $12.99; high Oversized Boyfriend Button-Down Corduroy Shirt $44.99. Most common regular prices $24.99, $39.99 and $19.99. Many kept items carry an 'App Exclusive Extra 20% Off' flag.

Gap Inc. product API (cid 3056582 Activewear > Leggings, brand on, market us, 1 page, StylodexBot UA): 27 styles; leggings only (titles with 'Legging'; wide-leg pants and flare sweatpants dropped). Regular = regularPrice of in-stock colorways with priceType R, or P (temporary promotion) without a markdown, clearance, final-sale or 'price as marked' flag; priceType M excluded. 22 styles: low High-Waisted PowerChill 7/8 Cotton Leggings $26.99; PowerSoft Crop $29.99; PowerSoft 7/8 and Full-Length $34.99; most PowerSoft and StudioSmooth pocket and Boundless styles $39.99; StudioSmooth Flare $44.99; high High-Waisted Seamless Jacquard Leggings $49.99.
